newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Blast kills man on boat off Lebanese coast.
newsitem.headline: Blast kills man on boat off Lebanese coast.

text.p: A Lebanese man was killed in an explosion on a boat near Israel's border with Lebanon on Monday, Israeli security sources said.
They said the blast occurred after Israeli coast guards fired automatic weapons at the boat as it approached the Jewish state's territorial waters. Other details were not immediately available.
The sources said Israeli authorities suspected militants were in the boat on their way to carrying out a guerrilla attack in the Jewish state.
They said coast guards spotted the boat at 5:30 a.m. (0230 GMT) and signalled it to stop before opening fire.
Timor Goksel, spokesman for the United Nations peacekeepers in Lebanon, said fishermen may have been on the boat with dynamite which they use to catch fish.
The Jewish state occupies a 15-km (nine-mile) wide zone in south Lebanon to protect its northern border against Moslem militants bent on ousting Israeli troops from the area.
